title: Analysis-In the AI era, Apple's strengths may become its constraints
title_zh: 分析-AI时代，苹果的优势或将成为其制约
summary: Apple built its empire on control. It also made Apple the world's top-valued company for much of the past decade, a position only overtaken by artificial ‌intelligence chipmaker Nvidia in 2024.
summary_zh: 苹果公司的帝国建立在控制之上。它还使苹果在过去十年的大部分时间里成为全球市值最高的公司，这一地位直到 2024 年才被人工智能芯片制造商 Nvidia 超越。

title: Morning Brief:  Ceasefire extended
title_zh: 早间简报：停火期限延长
summary: Tesla opens its books today, kicking off Big Tech quarterly results.
summary_zh: 特斯拉今天开始营业，揭开了大型科技公司季度业绩的序幕。

title: Here are the best — and worst — times of the year to buy Apple stock: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 以下是一年中购买苹果股票的最佳和最差时间：每日图表
summary: Historically, Apple stock tends to get its groove back in May. But before that seasonal tailwind kicks in, investors first have to get through a messy near-term setup: a dicey chart, a CEO transition, and earnings next week.
summary_zh: 从历史上看，苹果股票往往会在五月份恢复最佳状态。但在季节性顺风来临之前，投资者首先必须经历一个混乱的近期环境：不稳定的图表、首席执行官换届以及下周的盈利。

title: US investors crave predictability after Orban's overnight law changes
title_zh: 欧尔班一夜之间修改法律后，美国投资者渴望可预测性
summary: By Gergely Szakacs BUDAPEST, April 22 (Reuters) - U.S. investors in Hungary are hoping for a return to predictable policymaking after years of abrupt law changes and ad hoc measures, following centre-
summary_zh: 布达佩斯 4 月 22 日（路透社）——匈牙利的美国投资者希望在经历了多年突然的法律变更和临时措施之后，匈牙利的政策制定能够恢复到可预测的状态。

title: Australian social media ban marred by weak platform checks, tech providers say
title_zh: 技术提供商表示，澳大利亚社交媒体禁令因平台检查薄弱而受到损害
summary: Problems enforcing Australia's teen social media ban reflect social media platforms' weak deployment of tools available to run age checks rather than ‌the limits of the technology, an industry body representing the tech suppliers said.
summary_zh: 代表技术供应商的行业机构表示，澳大利亚青少年社交媒体禁令的执行问题反映了社交媒体平台用于运行年龄检查的工具部署薄弱，而不是技术的限制。

title: Tesla launches six-seater Model Y variant in India
title_zh: 特斯拉在印度推出六座 Model Y 变体
summary: April 22 (Reuters) - U.S. electric-vehicle maker Tesla on Wednesday launched a six-seater version of its best-selling Model Y, priced at 6.2 million rupees ($66,324.35), the company's website showed.
summary_zh: 路透 4 月 22 日 - 美国电动汽车制造商特斯拉网站显示，该公司周三推出了其最畅销 Model Y 的六座版本，售价为 620 万卢比（66,324.35 美元）。

title: Stocks gain, dollar wobbles as Trump extends Iran ceasefire
title_zh: 特朗普延长伊朗停火协议，股市上涨，美元波动
summary: SINGAPORE, April 22 (Reuters) - U.S. stock futures rose and the dollar wavered on Wednesday after President Donald Trump said he would indefinitely extend the Iran ceasefire keeping sentiment buoyed
summary_zh: 路透新加坡4月22日 - 美国总统特朗普表示将无限期延长伊朗停火协议，提振市场情绪，周三美国股指期货上涨，美元波动

title: Consumer watchdog group files suit alleging Meta profited on ads for scams
title_zh: 消费者监督组织提起诉讼，指控 Meta 通过诈骗广告获利
summary: The Consumer Federation of America has filed a class-action complaint against Meta Platforms alleging that the social-media giant has profited ‌from advertising for fraudulent activities on its platforms and misled users about ‌its efforts to combat the problem.
summary_zh: 美国消费者联合会已对 Meta Platforms 提起集体诉讼，指控这家社交媒体巨头通过其平台上的欺诈活动广告获利，并误导用户了解其解决这一问题的努力。

title: Microsoft must face $2.8 billion UK lawsuit over cloud computing licences
title_zh: 微软必须在英国面临 28 亿美元云计算许可证诉讼
summary: LONDON, April 21 () - Microsoft must face a mass lawsuit alleging it overcharged thousands of British businesses to use Windows Server software on ‌cloud computing services provided by Amazon, Google and Alibaba, a London tribunal ‌ruled on Tuesday.
summary_zh: 伦敦，4 月 21 日 - 伦敦一家法庭周二裁定，微软必须面临大规模诉讼，指控其向数千家英国企业在亚马逊、谷歌和阿里巴巴提供的云计算服务上使用 Windows Server 软件收取过高费用。
